answer_1.quote: Entity Linking (EL) is the task of associating a Named Entity (NE) mention ... to a unique identifier that describes what that mention refers to in a knowledge base (KB).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate both NER and ED models using the measurements of precision (fraction of extracted NEs that are correct), recall (fraction of NEs extracted out of all the gold-standard NEs), and Fscore (harmonic mean of precision and recall).
